capabilities.concept_generation: HIGH — generates 2-3 architectural visual alternatives based on text prompt
capabilities.layout_exploration: HIGH — rapid layout generation and spatial variation
capabilities.mood_direction_alternatives: HIGH — supports exploration of dark vs warm sandstone themes
capabilities.motion_ideas: MODERATE — generates conceptual animation transitions and micro-interaction descriptions
capabilities.platform_awareness: RESTRICTED — Stitch produces web/HTML/React-centric layouts; must NOT be used directly as mobile native code
capabilities.export_format: HTML/React DOM tree with Tailwind/CSS classes

stitch_responsibilities: Generating 2-3 visual layout alternatives per major screen (Explore, Detail, Plan, Transit)
Testing editorial contrast and card density before manual Figma component specification
figma_responsibilities: Semantic design token variables (Color, Typography, Spacing, Radius, Elevation)
Native component specifications (Auto Layout, Variants, Component Sets)
Platform-specific visual designs (Material 3 for Android, HIG for iOS)
Interactive clickable prototypes and handoff specs
hard_rules: RULE 1: Stitch-generated HTML/TSX code is NEVER committed to mobile/android or mobile/ios.
RULE 2: Stitch output is strictly an interim conceptual artifact.
RULE 3: All mobile production code is written by hand in native Jetpack Compose (Android) and SwiftUI (iOS) referencing approved Figma specifications.
